verses.english: Fear of the Bad Place, the Underworld

verses.pali: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṁ samatikkanto hoti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a noble disciple who has four things has gone beyond all fear of being reborn in a bad place, the underworld.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti—
verses.english: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.
ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: And they have the ethical conduct loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṁ samatikkanto hotī”ti.
verses.english: A noble disciple who has these four things has gone beyond all fear of being reborn in a bad place, the underworld.”
